author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕುಹಕ ಕುಟಿಲತೆಯಿರಲು ನಿನನಾಶ ಸಿದ್ಧವಹು
ದಹಿಸದಿರೆ ಅರಿಮೆಗಳ ಸೋಲುಗಳು ಖಚಿತ
ಸಹಿಸುತಲೆ ಗುಣದೋಷ ಜೊತೆನಡೆದು ಬೆಂಬಲಿಸೆ
ಕಹಿಕಮರಿ ಸಿಹಿನಿನಗೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: With sneering and crookedness, your ruin is ready;
if you don’t burn away the inner enemies, defeats are certain;
if you bear with good and bad and walk along supporting people,
the bitterness withers and sweetness is yours, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Mockery and scheming lead to ruin, and unconquered inner enemies to defeat. Accept people with their faults, support them, and life turns sweet.
